minutes_text:
AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES
  March 14, 2012
  7:00 P.M.

NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the
Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to
5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City
Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626)
812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at
213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California

Call To Order

Chairperson Kindred called the meeting to order at 7:01 p.m.

Pledge of Allegiance

Commissioner Donnelson led the flag salute.

Roll Call

Members present:  AVILA, LEE, KINDRED, MILLNER, DONNELSON
Members Absent:

Approval of Minutes

None

Staff Present

Assistant Director of Economic and Community Development, Conal McNamara; BBK Attorney,
Mal Richardson and Assistant Planner, Kim Cooke.

Public Participation

Art Morales spoke.
 PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES -draft
March 14, 2012
Page 2 of 3

Public Hearings

  1.  Variance No. V-2011-09 & Minor Use Permit No. MUP-2012-03
  Location:  360 N. Citrus Avenue (APN: 8628-004-166)
  Applicant:  Azusa Pacific University, property owner for Chuck Crossland
  and Tim Mincy, Night & Day Inc.

A request for approval of a Variance and Minor Use Permit to allow a health/fitness club to
occupy a 15,000 sq. ft., tenant space formerly occupied by Big Lots, located within the
Promenade Shopping Center.

The item was removed from the agenda and staff provided an explanation to the Commission
regarding why it can be approved at staff level.

  2.  Modification to Use Permit No. UP 2010-02
  Applicant:  J. Daniel Fox, Wireless Development Services, LLC
  Location:  1801 W. Gladstone Street (APN: 8615-002-015)

A request for approval of Modification to Use Permit to allow the replacement of six existing
AT&T panel antennas with twelve new AT&T "LTE" antennas on an existing stealth (mono-
pine) telecommunication facility.

Ms. Cooke presented the item and answered questions of the Planning Commission.

Ms. Hernandez, applicant’s representative, was present to answer questions of the Planning
Commission.

The following person provided testimony during the Public Hearing:
Art Morales

Commissioner Avila made a motion to adopt resolution to approve Modification to Use Permit
No. UP 2012-02. Commissioner Donnelson seconded the motion.

The vote was 5-0. The public was advised of the 20 day appeal period.

Unfinished Business

None

New Business

None

1.  Staff update from the City Council meeting.
Mr. McNamara indicated that the Gold Line Authority would make a presentation in the near
future and told Commission about filling out Form 700.

Discussion Items from the Planning Commission

Commissioner Avila discussed reported on past events and discussed upcoming events.
Commissioner Millner reported shopping carts for pick up in her neighborhood and Mr.
McNamara addressed her concerns.

Adjournment

The Commission voted unanimously to adjourn at 7:35 p.m.
Regularly scheduled Planning Commission meeting of March 28, 2012, canceled.
The next regularly scheduled Planning Commission meeting is April 11, 2012.
